Strategy: Combine the [28,42] sweet-band bonus with a mild penalty on the [6,20] sliver band, testing whether a weaker sliver penalty works better.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if 28 <= r - item <= 42 else 0) - (15 if 6 <= r - item <= 20 else 0) for r in bins]
```
